operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: stop writes and scheduled work, retain the exact source and private configuration, export the installation with rer export, restore into fresh empty resources with rer import, establish a fresh owner, and compare a real re-export before routing traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
